title: Insect King in Cavern
description: A skeletal insectoid creature wearing a golden crown stands in a dark cavern, holding a handful of dripping black substance over a large pile of coins and rings. Ethereal ghostly figures and multiple glowing golden rings float in the smoky background.
prompt: A skeletal insect creature with beetle wings and large eyes, wearing an ornate golden crown, stands inside a dark smoky cavern. It holds a dripping black substance in one hand over a large pile of gold coins and rings on the ground. Several ghostly hooded figures kneel in the background while glowing golden rings float in the air. Monochrome ink drawing with selective gold accents, detailed linework, dark fantasy atmosphere.
